CustomObject.description: One column within a table definition, with a sequence number. Same reasoning as Quote Document Grouping: Custom Metadata has no ordered list, so print order has to be carried by a child record rather than by a delimited field. A table definition with NO column records emits a default set - a label column plus one per measure in its measure set - so every existing definition keeps working with no authoring. Records are needed only when a table wants a subset, a different order, or a non-measure field.
CustomObject.label: Quote Document Column Def
